reviews.frank_statement: A deterministic same-language Clay View Compiler remains necessary even in a Clay-native FRANK.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A sufficiently Clay-native target model can consume one canonical surface directly and reader-specific compilation only adds overhead/confounds.
reviews.falsifier: Target full-FT Qwen shows canonical direct input Pareto-dominating operation/reader-specific projections across correctness, cost and robustness.
independent_checks: NVIDIA Nemotron-Mini-4B COVE test: compiled operation view 11/12 vs raw 4/12 while prompt tokens 289 vs 458
LLVM MLIR independently demonstrates progressive multi-level/dialect lowering rather than one universal representation
2026 AIR independently uses a conservative agent IR distinct from framework/prompt source surfaces
adversarial_checks: CC10 and NVIDIA 4B compact-symbol arms show that arbitrary compression can reduce reliability or fail the output contract
CC11 rail Pareto analysis finds no single observed surface optimum across both task families
reviews.reason: The compiler boundary is strengthened, but it should become a multi-rail reader/task compiler with explicit proof obligations rather than privilege one CLAY_MODEL serialization.
reviews.claycode_action: replace fixed-view assumption with CC-RC1.6 MRSC rail planning plus translation validation

reviews.frank_statement: Full-model adaptation should make compact native Clay a useful generated/deliberative model language.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Even after full-model adaptation, compact discrete Clay may not outperform richer canonical or latent/hybrid rails on broad OOD tasks.
reviews.falsifier: Matched target-Qwen full-FT factorial with fixed compute shows compact P2 robustly improves correctness/OOD/cost without capability loss versus canonical and latent/hybrid controls.
independent_checks: Generic NVIDIA 4B compact P2 proxy failed its output contract while raw/typed remained usable
Interlat shows a separate continuous communication route can be competitive, so discrete compactness is not the only plausible native rail
adversarial_checks: Do not treat generic untrained 4B failure as target-model falsification
Require retained-capability and OOD controls after full-model adaptation
reviews.reason: The owner-fixed target remains a project direction, but its empirical benefit and optimal rail mix remain untested on the target checkpoint.

reviews.frank_statement: Continuous hidden activations/KV are physical transient state and explicit generated/deliberative semantics are Clay.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Hidden-state/KV channels are only implementation detail and should not be modeled as a distinct functional communication/cognition rail.
reviews.falsifier: Target/heterogeneous matched tests show no task-specific causal information contribution from latent message content after controlling training, extra passes, sender/receiver alignment and token budget.
independent_checks: ACL 2026 Interlat demonstrates agents communicating entirely through last hidden states and reports competitive performance plus up to 24x compressed inference acceleration
Coconut and its official implementation provide an independent continuous-reasoning mechanism, while community controls motivate curriculum confound tests
adversarial_checks: Latent payload hash cannot be interpreted as semantic equivalence
Require message substitution/lesion and training/pass controls before claiming causal latent communication
reviews.reason: Continuous state remains non-canonical and non-authoritative, but current evidence justifies modeling it as an explicit functional P3 rail with separate causal identity and receipts rather than only passive physical substrate.
reviews.claycode_action: add S.LATENT_CHANNEL_RECEIPT and canonical reconciliation gate without granting latent state truth/authority

reviews.frank_statement: Model/native-Clay output is proposal, not execution authority; effects remain externally capability-gated.
ancestry_families: FRANK-C5/C6 plus ClayCode shared authority lineage
reviews.counterhypothesis: A typed/native agent language can safely make model-generated effect expressions authoritative without a separate runtime gate.
reviews.falsifier: A formally controlled target architecture proves the generated object itself is a revocable, issuer-bound capability under all supported effect paths, with no external mediation needed.
independent_checks: CAIS 2026 tracked-capability work uses a programming-language safety harness and static capability tracking for agent effects
Proof-Carrying Agent Actions 2026 binds portable action/runtime/approval receipts outside model proposal text
adversarial_checks: MRSC rail planner and reconciliation receipts are explicitly non-authoritative
Cross-rail agreement cannot mint a capability
reviews.reason: Independent agent-security work continues to separate agent intent/proposal from deterministic capability/action governance.

reviews.frank_statement: Vector/tensor representations require explicit semantic type, axis/basis and provenance; physical similarity is not semantic authority.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A sufficiently strong embedding geometry can serve directly as directed relation identity and semantic-class authority.
reviews.falsifier: Across held-out models/tasks, vector identity alone preserves direction, n-ary roles, epistemic class and authority with lower error than explicit anchors under adversarial role/class swaps.
independent_checks: Fresh NVIDIA nv-embedqa-e5-v5 test made role-reversed directed relations more similar than role-preserving paraphrases in both constructed pairs
Same-content FACT/ACTIVATION_PRIOR/PROPOSAL/AUTHORITY_CAP variants remained highly similar in the NVIDIA embedding test
adversarial_checks: Use role reversal and semantic-class relabeling as mandatory negative controls
Do not promote the constructed embedding result to all models/geometries
reviews.reason: Direct hosted embedding evidence supports the need for exact role/class anchors around dense representations.
reviews.claycode_action: require exact semantic anchors/role binding in all P2/P3 receipts

reviews.frank_statement: Projection identity and projection semantic correctness are distinct; ProjectionProofReceipt binds input/view/wire/compiler state.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Binding the canonical input hash and compiler version is enough; exact emitted-view binding is redundant.
reviews.falsifier: Adversarial mutations of emitted reader payloads cannot alter semantics without changing already-bound source/compiler identity or being caught by downstream semantic checks.
independent_checks: CC11 new 100k fuzz test: source-bound-only receipt accepted 20,112/100,000 projected-value mutations/attacks overall; adding exact projected-view binding plus semantic checks rejected 100,000/100,000 constructed mutations
Translation-validation literature independently treats each concrete lowering result as a validation object rather than trusting translator identity alone
adversarial_checks: Five mutation classes: role swap, class cast, stale epoch, semantic substitution, projected value change
Zero unsafe accepts is scoped only to the constructed mutation family
reviews.reason: The new discriminating test directly supports FRANK's existing input/output projection binding and sharpens it into a hard dual-binding requirement for ClayCode.
reviews.claycode_action: make canonical_input_hash + projected_view_hash mandatory in S.PROJECTION_RECEIPT_V2
